factor_indicator_logic.value: Negative cumulative return over value window
factor_indicator_logic.lowvol: Negative annualized volatility over last L days
factor_indicator_logic.drawdown: Max drawdown over L days (closer to 0 is better)
factor_indicator_logic.income: Sum(dividends over last 252 sessions) / last price in window

factor_indicator_logic.value: 1 - price percentile in [min,max] over Lv (cheaper in range)
factor_indicator_logic.lowvol: Negative beta vs equal-weight cross-sectional index
factor_indicator_logic.income: Sum(dividends over last 252 sessions) / last price in window

factor_indicator_logic.trend: Short MA / long MA - 1 (rising trend proxy)

data_quality.warning: Price panel starts 2012-05-18 (requested 2010-01-01); early chart weights may use placeholder allocations until lookback is ready.

narrative_facts.backtest_methodology: Dynamic rebalance: each date re-runs factor screen (Top N) then allocator weights. When holdout is enabled, trial selection and Pro champions use in-sample metrics only; holdout tail is reported once for generalization (oos_leaderboard), not re-used each Pro round.

ai_param_generation.rationale: Constrained customization mode: named optimizer scenarios on a fixed small universe (anchor_close / full_drift / defensive / theme).
rationales_by_round: Constrained customization mode: named optimizer scenarios on a fixed small universe (anchor_close / full_drift / defensive / theme).

narrative_facts.report_analysis_note: Trial selection and Pro champions use in-sample metrics only when holdout is enabled. Report narrative should compare in-sample, out-of-sample, and full-sample (ttl) horizons.
